_meta.description: Maps HTMX attributes (hx-*) to Spashta CKG Semantic Roles.
_meta.changelog_2.1: Replaced dead contains_attributes rule with has_outgoing_edge (implemented in engine 2.1). Templates with calls_api/triggers_event/submits_form edges are now detected as Component. Added Fragment partial detection via file_path_contains.

mappings.notes: Templates with HTMX interactions (hx-get, hx-post, etc.) are interactive UI Components. The HTML builder already emits calls_api edges for hx-* attributes — this rule detects Templates that have those edges.
Partial templates in partials/ directories are HTMX swap targets. 100% confident — standard Django+HTMX convention.
